scope: Working-tree scoped implementation and regression evidence. This is not a whole-tree freeze or final endurance acceptance.

inventory.derivation: Validated mission-library index original authored standard Solo rows plus the existing 139 Journey index entries. Demo catalog descriptors join exact campaign, level and revision; no current-rules projections or custom combinations.

behavior: Metadata-only discovery exposes base, bundled and archived Classic performances from Journey and cross-mode entry, even without installed packs.

Selected sources stream exact indexed bytes with bounded size and SHA-256 validation, then use native preparePack, canonical prepared-pack identity, standard execution catalog and existing loadDemoSources replay admission.
Original reviewed replay compatibility and strict generated replay checks remain unchanged. No simulation identity, authored level or recording corpus changes were made by this increment.
Native browser image decoding now accepts optional cancellation and retires temporary Image callbacks/src immediately; it stops subsequent pack image decodes.
A shared lazy-source lease preserves frozen player getters, releases Classic and Journey entry references, and retains async disposal result/error after abort.
Source-ID merge retains existing personal recordings, qualified live bots, improvisation and reviewed choices.
Uninstalled Classic Fresh uses the existing guarded exact ordinary chooser handoff. Existing installed locked missions retain isolated practice fallback; no installation or unlock is granted.

Native Solo source descriptors now carry their admitted difficulty variant consistently, so existing personal/improvised/live sources and lazy authored recordings share the same Standard level visit. An actual merged 240-level catalog completes two full no-repeat cycles; native qualified bot metadata and personal Gentle identity are checked separately.

staleFixtureRepairs.explanation: Existing pack tests injected 1x1 dimensions for larger current authored images and inherited a changed pack version in a synthetic foundation fixture. The fixture decoder now derives expected dimensions from actual bounded image headers; intentionally mismatched dimensions still reject. The delayed atomic-import fixture admits exactly its one intended image, and synthetic foundation explicitly pins its declared 1.0.0 version. Production pack validation is unchanged.

browser.sourceBinding: That receipt independently hashes source files before and after. Final async-retirement refinement to solo-source-owner.mjs and explicit source difficulty metadata in demo-sources.mjs followed the first Chromium run. Focused native/source/rotation regressions pass after both changes; final three-engine runtime refresh remains pending.

limitations: The bounded Chromium probe fully played one selected base, current and archived performance, not all 101 Classic performances. Existing corpus qualification remains independently recorded elsewhere.
The Node packed-replay fixture omits artwork and uses no fake image decoder; actual authored image decoding is exercised by the selected browser performances.
Final frozen-source three-engine browser/Fresh/resource refresh, publishing-profile capacity validation, and a complete 120-minute actual wall-clock rotation remain separate acceptance gates.

fairnessRegression.explanation: The first regression fixture incorrectly expected a qualified live bot in the current base-only catalog. The corrected actual merge checks personal, improvisation and qualified recordings; the existing native qualified-bot source fixture independently checks explicit Standard variant metadata. No authored content or bot qualification was invented.
